name: pdf-tool
description: Teach AI agents to inspect, create, and edit PDFs through a self-describing, bounded CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect, create, and edit PDF files
interface.longDescription: A focused Agent Skill for a versioned agent contract, bounded PDF inspection, structured output, and transactional edits.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this PDF and summarize its structure.
Fill these PDF form fields and verify the result.
Apply these PDF edits as one safe transaction.
